probe_notes: Seed run (v1.0). Most vendor API documentation is gated behind auth, redirects, or is not directly crawlable by a public WebFetch. That finding is itself part of the agent-readiness picture. All scores this run are doc-only confidence. Live-probed scoring will follow as sandbox credentials are acquired.

structured_pricing.notes: REST API returns structured responses. JSON is implied by REST convention and SDK examples, though explicit schema for price object not fully inspected this run.

api_order.notes: POST /orders-v1 endpoint documented for order placement. Payment integration path not explicitly described in public quick-start; assumed partial.

order_status.notes: GET /orders-orderId-v1 polling endpoint documented. No webhook mentioned in public docs excerpt.

auth_accessibility.notes: OAuth2 flow referenced in developer guide. Self-serve sign-up available at developers.shapeways.com.

rate_limits.notes: No rate limit documentation surfaced in public pages this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: Guide mentions 'printability checks' but no evidence that DFM warnings are returned as structured fields in the quote response. Scoring conservative pending live probe.

ttfq_speed.notes: No documented SLA or timing metric for quote response found in public docs this run.

headlines: Seed run — baseline established for 7 vendors
Top composite: Shapeways (63) — only vendor with self-serve OAuth2 + documented order status polling
Big finding: 5 of 7 vendors' public API docs are gated, 404, or auth-walled — a structural barrier to agent adoption
